propositions: Eight permanently-aliased environment and config keys (REBAR_NO_SYNC, COMPACT_THRESHOLD, SCRATCH_BASE_DIR, REBAR_ACLI_TIMEOUT, RECONCILER_ABSENT_GET_BUDGET, REBAR_ID_GUARD_MODE, REBAR_VERIFY_OVERLAP_ENABLED, verify.overlap_enabled) must be removed from active parsing and warning paths in _deprecations.py, _config_sources.py, and _config_sections.py.

All functional test consumers across five test files must be migrated from deprecated aliases to their canonical replacements, preserving typed behavior and transformed semantics (inverse-pull for REBAR_NO_SYNC, unsafe-bypass for REBAR_ID_GUARD_MODE).

Documentation, examples, and guides must be updated to use only canonical spellings; all residual occurrences of the eight removed tokens must be classified as ADR references or dated historical records.
An ADR must record the operator-approved permanent-to-removed reclassification, cite the Janitor approval, and explain the simplification rationale.
Tests must verify that canonical replacements retain their prior typed behavior and that old spellings no longer have active parser or warning support.
